guidelines.detail: refines GW-06 (The description pairs a required action with an action performed only if necessary, and the reference uses inclusive gateways for the split and join. This refines GW-06 by specifying how to model a required branch alongside a conditional branch.)

same as LRN-002 (The description distinguishes clarifying the shipping method and deciding whether special shipping is needed from the shipping options that follow. The generated labels substitute possible outcomes for those decisions or clarifications. This is already covered in substance by LRN-002, which says to label elements for the action or outcome described at each stage and not substitute another action o)

refines LANE-01 (The description assigns work to the secretary, logistics department head, and warehousemen, while the records show missing internal lanes and activities and an extra pool/message flow. This refines LANE-01 by specifying that stated activities belong in the lane of their assigned role. The description also mentions invitations to logistics companies, so the records do not support a blanket rule aga)

same as LRN-031 (S6 describes work that can happen in the meantime, and S7 makes readiness a prerequisite for the later activity. F7 and F9 show the missing parallel branch structure. Since all required work must be ready, use a parallel join rather than copying an exclusive-gateway choice from the reference.)

same as LRN-017 (The description specifies different handling for large and small amounts, while the reference records an exclusive gateway with no generated counterpart. The learned guideline already covers modeling mutually exclusive alternatives as distinct activities on exclusive-gateway branches. The label pairs do not establish a need to copy the reference labels; the description supports the generated wordi)

same as LRN-034 (The description assigns work to several roles and departments, while the collaboration records show corresponding activities without counterparts in the generated model. The guideline directly addresses representing internal responsibilities as lanes and assigning activities accordingly.)

same as LRN-017 (The description distinguishes large- and small-quantity cases that lead to different shipping procedures. The missing gateway flows support that this decision structure was not represented. This is essentially covered by the learned guideline for modeling mutually exclusive alternatives on exclusive-gateway branches.)

refines COL-01 (The description specifies invitations to three logistics companies and selection among them, while the generated model adds a specific numbered company and a message flow with no reference counterpart. This refines the guidance to represent distinct participants by clarifying that their identities should not be made more specific than the description supports.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one activity is required while an independent activity is performed only when a condition holds: Model the activities as branches of an inclusive gateway, with the required activity on an always-taken branch and the optional activity on a conditional branch; use an inclusive join before any subsequent activity that depends on their completion.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one activity is required while an independent activity is performed only when a condition holds

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies actions or outcomes at distinct stages of a process: Label each BPMN element to reflect the action or outcome described at that stage; do not substitute a different action, a later-stage action, or an unsupported outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes a decision or clarification about how an activity will be performed from the alternative actions that may follow

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description assigns activities to multiple roles or departments within one organization: Represent those responsibilities as lanes within one process, and place each stated activity in the lane of the role or department assigned to it; do not model those internal roles as separate participant pools or connect them with message flows.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description assigns activities to multiple roles or departments within one organization

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a distinct activity is performed while other activities are in progress and that a later activity depends on their completion: Model the distinct activity and the other required work on concurrent branches, then synchronize those branches before the dependent activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one activity can occur while other independent work is underway and that a later activity requires all of that work to be ready

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists mutually exclusive ways to achieve an outcome: Model each stated alternative as a distinct activity on an exclusive-gateway branch, rather than combining the alternatives into one generic activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes mutually exclusive handling paths based on a stated quantity threshold or other condition

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that multiple follow-up activities after the same point must all occur, without describing them as alternatives: Model the activities as concurrent branches using a parallel gateway, and synchronize them with a parallel gateway before any subsequent activity that depends on all branches being complete.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that work may proceed concurrently and that a later action must wait until all required work is complete

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that an interaction involves a set of external organizations but does not identify any organization individually: Represent the external participants at the level of identity the description supports; do not invent a specific numbered participant when the organizations are described only as a group.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that an interaction involves a set of external organizations but does not identify any organization individually
